_doc: Review policy read by review_gate.py. CI reads this file from the BASE branch (the trusted checkout), so a PR cannot remove itself from the list. second_family_paths: fnmatch globs ("*" also matches "/"); a diff touching any of them needs a passing review (CLEAN, or FINDINGS disposed) from TWO different model families before the review check goes green. See docs/operations/github-workflow-conventions.md#second-family-review.
